topics.purpose: Define exact finding when multiple active definitions, members or aliases claim an incompatible canonical identity.

semantics.identity_rule: Each collision finding has explicit identity.
semantics.claimant_rule: All conflicting source/member refs are exact.
semantics.kind_rule: Definition-vs-definition, alias-vs-canonical, member-vs-member and cross-kind collisions are distinguished.
semantics.severity_rule: Active incompatible identity collision is blocking.
semantics.resolution_rule: No claimant wins by path, timestamp or load order.
semantics.authority_rule: Finding does not itself rewrite identities.

invariants.rule: Whole-tree reconciliation operates only on exact accepted/candidate source snapshots, identities, references and declared semantics; it never repairs ambiguity through filename, path order, timestamp, nearest-name or UI layout heuristics.

A contract, closure set or repository remains unlocked/not-ready until all required reconciliation findings for its declared readiness profile are explicitly resolved or accepted through an explicit bounded exception.
